description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
summary: Superpowers is a composable skills layer that drops into whatever agent harness you already run—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, a dozen others—and enforces a spec → plan → subagent-execute loop with review, so the agent stops barreling straight into code. That's the structure I want baked in underneath AgentOn Pocket and PenguPool: when I'm routing sessions or driving them from my phone, the methodology has to be the default behavior, not something I re-prompt every time. The "written for an enthusiastic junior with poor taste and an aversion to testing" plan format is a small detail I appreciate, because it's the kind of constraint that makes a two-hour autonomous run actually legible when I come back to it.
